name: ai.arcangel/arcangel

isolation.method: unavailable on this host (no unprivileged user/network namespaces) - server processes ran with normal network egress

tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Return the authenticated Arcangel account (id, email, profile).

tools.name: list_patents
tools.description: List patent matters owned by the token user.

tools.name: get_patent
tools.description: Get one owned patent matter by id, including workflow answers (how it works, claims, inventors, figures). Payment, checkout, and Stripe fields are omi

tools.name: list_trademarks
tools.description: List trademark matters owned by the token user.

tools.name: get_trademark
tools.description: Get one owned trademark matter by id, including workflow answers. Payment, checkout, and Stripe fields are omitted.

tools.name: create_patent
tools.description: Create a draft patent matter. Requires bot:write.

tools.name: update_patent
tools.description: Patch allowed draft fields on an owned patent. Requires bot:write.

tools.name: create_trademark
tools.description: Create a draft trademark matter. Requires bot:write.

tools.name: update_trademark
tools.description: Patch allowed draft fields on an owned trademark. Requires bot:write.
